people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus, seeing that he became very sad, said, “How hard it is for those who have riches to enter into God’s Kingdom!
translations.bsb: Seeing the man’s sadness, Jesus said, “How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!
translations.kjv: And when Jesus saw that he was very sorrowful, he said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
translations.asv: And Jesus seeing him said, How hardly shall they that have riches enter into the kingdom of God!
